name: model-compass
description: Evidence-based LLM selection across generic enterprise use cases

scripts.test: sh -c 'if find src -type f | grep -Eq "\.(test|spec)\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs|cjs)$"; then vitest run; else echo "No JS/TS test files to run"; fi'
scripts.lint: sh -c 'if find src -type f | grep -Eq "\.(ts|tsx|js|mjs|cjs)$"; then eslint src; else echo "No JS/TS sources to lint"; fi'
scripts.type-check: sh -c 'if find src -type f | grep -Eq "\.(ts|tsx)$"; then tsc --noEmit; else echo "No TypeScript sources to type-check"; fi'
